header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH,
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None is present on behalf of the petitioner nor any intimation is
received. This petition was filed in the year 2022 and thereafter matter was
fixed on 03.09.2025. Since then, no efforts have been made by the counsel for
the petitioner to get the matter fixed before the Court or to proceed with it.
Today position remains same. It appears that counsel for the petitioner has
body: lost interest to pursue with the matter. Accordingly, this petition is dismissed for non-prosecution.
